notes: model_artifact_bytes is the acquired model snapshot file size, including cache hits; it is not network traffic. model_download_bytes remains null unless separately measured.
model_acquisition_seconds includes download or cache lookup; model_load_seconds is construction after acquisition; initialization includes both.
Cold first request includes lazy model loading and possibly download; pre-cache weights for load-only comparison.
Only compare reports with identical manifest and audio hashes; separate results by language and recording condition.
WER uses NFKC/casefolded word tokens and is most useful for whitespace-separated languages.
CER uses NFKC/casefolded Unicode code points with whitespace removed; punctuation is retained.
Latency includes upload and service inference. Compare cold-start and warm runs separately.
Record the same corpus, model, device, compute type, and hardware when comparing configurations.

model_distribution.safe_archive_check: all members regular files/directories, no absolute/traversal/symlink/hardlink/device entries, unpacked total under 6GiB
model_distribution.upstream_checkpoint_revision: not published in archive; exact hash identifies the artifact

tokenizer.construction: prepare_rhasspy_tokenizer.py verifies rank/special token IDs against archived vocabulary.txt

limitations: Synthetic voices only; not representative human accuracy.
Shared VM with uncontrolled background CPU activity, including a separate local Qwen test; observed timing is not an isolated causal comparison.
Cold-first-request excludes prior artifact download and service startup; it includes lazy model initialization and inference.
Upstream training/checkpoint revision is not published in this Rhasspy archive; use the release URL and exact archive/model hashes as artifact identity.
No GPU is visible; GPU memory is unmeasured, not zero.
